observations.behavior: Adds a sample-data cache and conditional replacement of chart queries.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the home tab to show pre-generated placeholder charts before ingestion without executing live backend queries.

observations.behavior: Renders SampleDataState wrapper around cached results when available; otherwise renders live query result.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides immediate visual feedback while preserving eventual consistency with actual event data once ingested.

observations.behavior: Tests that after an ingestion status change, the component switches from cached samples to real queries.,
observations.posthog_connection: Demonstrates runtime behavior and compatibility expectations for this caching strategy in production scenarios.

observations.limitations: Only frontend implementation is shown; no backend or database changes are visible. No tests cover edge cases like malformed options or missing breakdowns. No migration or rollback path is demonstrated.

review.limitations: Only frontend implementation is shown; no backend or database changes are visible. No tests cover edge cases like malformed options or missing breakdowns. No migration or rollback path is demonstrated.
review.reason: This chunk adds a bounded capability: supplying synthetic sample data and replacing it with live results once events arrive. The implementation includes shared-sample generation, conditional rendering, and a test asserting the switch. It does not demonstrate broader systemic risk reduction or cross-component dependency handling required for tier 3.
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant to user experience and perceived responsiveness of home tab charts before project setup. Does not establish adoption or incident avoidance without further context.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on provided hunks; absence of backend or configuration changes could affect actual benefit and supportability.
